Historical seed rows under known_evidence were captured with request-level disable_thinking; the published 102400-token bundle separately validates this preset with thinking enabled.

The published profile used a 1024-token retrieval allowance so hidden reasoning could finish before the required client-visible exact answer; its preceding 512-token diagnostic is disclosed with the evidence.

context.validated_for: Uncached long-context retrieval and sustained generation with thinking enabled, q8_0 KV, parallel=1, and built-in draft-MTP.

caveats: Measured only on one AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT (gfx1030) through ROCm/HIP under the COMPUTE power profile; do not generalize to other 16GB Radeon cards.
Thinking remained enabled. The passing profile allowed up to 1024 retrieval output tokens so the model could finish hidden reasoning and emit the required visible exact answer.

A preceding 512-token retrieval allowance produced one visible-answer failure out of two retrieval checks despite passing prompt coverage and sustained generation; that sanitized diagnostic receipt is published alongside the passing run.
The result validates this exact 100K q8_0-KV, parallel=1, built-in draft-MTP preset; changing backend, KV precision, parallelism, speculation, or power profile is a different lane.
